topics.topic: Le Passé Composé avec le Verbe "Avoir": Regular past participles (-é, -i, -u)
learningObjectives: Explain the formation of the passé composé with auxiliary verb avoir
Form regular past participles of first, second, and third group verbs
Recount weekend and vacation activities in the past tense

topics.topic: Le Passé Composé avec le Verbe "Être": Verbs of motion and reflexive verbs
learningObjectives: Memorize the 14 verbs of motion conjugated with auxiliary être (DR MRS VANDERTRAMP)
Apply participle agreement rules with subject gender and number
Conjugate reflexive verbs in the past compound tense

topics.topic: La Lettre Informelle en Français: Writing letters to French-speaking penpals
learningObjectives: Structure an informal letter (lieu, date, formule d'appel, corps, salutations)
Incorporate descriptive narrative details about school and Nigerian festivities
Close letters with courteous French sign-offs (Amicalement, Bien à toi)

topics.topic: Les Moyens de Transport et les Voyages: Taking the bus, train, and airplane
learningObjectives: Identify transport modes (l'avion, le train, le bateau, le car, la moto)
Use appropriate transport prepositions (en voiture, à vélo, à pied)
Purchase tickets and inquire about travel departures at a French station

topics.topic: La Météo et le Climat: Weather forecasts and seasonal descriptions
learningObjectives: Use idiomatic weather expressions (Il fait beau, il pleut, il fait chaud)
Describe the four European seasons and the two Nigerian seasons (saison sèche / pluvieuse)
Present an oral weather forecast as a television broadcaster

topics.topic: L'Expression des Sentiments et des Émotions: Joy, sadness, surprise, fear
learningObjectives: Express joy, anxiety, anger, and enthusiasm using idiomatic French adjectives
Use expressions like Être content(e) de, avoir peur de, être surpris(e)
React empathetically to good and bad news in casual conversation

topics.topic: Contrôle Continu et Évaluation Orale de Mi-Semestre
learningObjectives: Evaluate pupil mastery of past tenses and letter writing conventions
Examine oral narration of past events in timed spoken tests
Provide corrective instruction on agreement of past participles

topics.topic: L'Imparfait de l'Indicatif: Habitual past descriptions and states of being
learningObjectives: Formulate the stem and endings of the imperfect tense (-ais, -ais, -ait...)
Distinguish between completed actions (passé composé) and background descriptions (imparfait)
Describe childhood memories and past habitual routines in Nigeria

topics.topic: Les Pronoms Compléments d'Objet Direct (COD: le, la, l', les)
learningObjectives: Identify direct object nouns in spoken and written French sentences
Replace nouns with direct object pronouns to avoid unnecessary repetition
Place pronouns correctly before the conjugated verb and in compound tenses

topics.topic: La Francophonie et les Pays Francophones d'Afrique de l'Ouest
learningObjectives: Identify neighboring French-speaking countries in West Africa (Bénin, Niger, Cameroun, Togo)
Discuss cultural and economic ties between Nigeria and Francophone Africa
Highlight the importance of bilingualism in ECOWAS and international diplomacy

topics.topic: L'Impératif: Giving commands, safety warnings, and instructions
learningObjectives: Formulate imperative verbs for tu, nous, and vous without subject pronouns
Issue classroom instructions, traffic commands, and cooking recipes
Form negative imperatives with ne ... pas

topics.topic: Révision Générale et Préparation Intensive à l'Examen du BECE
learningObjectives: Review past BECE examination papers and marking rubrics
Polish essay writing techniques, reading comprehension, and translation
Reinforce speed and accuracy in multiple-choice grammar questions

topics.topic: Examen Terminal et Évaluation Globale pour le BECE
learningObjectives: Complete official Junior Secondary certification examination in French
Assess conversational fluency in standardized oral interview panels
Transmit final moderated results to the State Examination Board
